new_libraries.name: SmtpMini
new_libraries.author: Davide Lupi <copida.soft@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Minimal SMTP client for ESP32 with RAM and filesystem attachments.
new_libraries.paragraph: Lightweight Arduino library for sending emails via SMTP over implicit TLS (port 465) or STARTTLS (port 587), with text or HTML body and attachments from RAM or any fs::FS filesystem, using streaming Base64 encoding to keep memory usage low. Supports server-certificate verification with a PEM CA certificate in SMTPS and STARTTLS modes.
